manifest: MEMENTO third-party license and origin manifest

authority.machineReadable: THIS FILE (resources/THIRD-PARTY.json) is the machine-readable authority for every third-party component that rides the MEMENTO distribution.
authority.humanReadable: NOTICE.md (electron-app root) is the human-readable attribution registry derived from this manifest.
authority.verbatimTexts: resources/licenses/ carries the verbatim license texts that MUST ride every distribution (each entry's licenseTextSha256 below pins its exact bytes). The wintun bespoke text stays at resources/wintun/wintun-LICENSE.txt (Phase B0 provenance).
authority.pinAuthority: electron/core-versions.json is the single source of truth for core versions; electron/wintunPin.ts for the wintun artifact identity; electron/aether-versions.json for the Aether update-service pins; the two package-lock.json files for npm versions.
authority.updateRule: Any component bump re-verifies the license from the official source and updates THIS file + NOTICE.md + resources/licenses/ in the SAME reviewed commit (the wintunPin bump discipline, generalized).

scope.covered: Every third-party component that rides the built distribution (the electron-builder portable exe): the bundled core binaries and driver, the Electron runtime shell, the main-process runtime npm dependency, every npm package actually imported by the renderer (bundled into dist/ by vite-plugin-singlefile, fonts inlined via assetsInlineLimit), and the datasets the app fetches at runtime into the user data dir.
scope.verificationBasis: Live evidence gathered 2026-09-20: license facts re-verified from upstream sources (LICENSE files fetched at the exact pinned tags; registry mirrors cross-checked); renderer imports enumerated from src/ (grep of every import statement); npm versions read from the two package-lock.json files; binary hashes cross-checked against the on-disk pin authorities.

bundled.name: Xray-core
bundled.role: primary proxy core (vmess/vless/trojan/ss/socks) — runs as the xray.exe child process
bundled.licenseProvenance: Fetched verbatim 2026-09-20 from the pinned tag: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XTLS/Xray-core/v25.1.1/LICENSE (373 lines); license id cross-checked against the repo README badge, deps.dev and pkg.go.dev (all MPL-2.0).
bundled.delivery: Bundled at build time as resources/xray/xray.exe (sync-resources from the legacy Tauri tree) AND auto-downloaded at runtime by electron/download.ts from the official XTLS GitHub releases when absent — both paths pinned to v25.1.1.
bundled.pinAuthority: electron/core-versions.json ("xray": "v25.1.1") + the XRAY_VERSION constant in electron/paths.ts
bundled.compliance: MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft; MEMENTO links to the core as a separate executable via its standard CLI/config interface and modifies nothing upstream; the verbatim license text rides in resources/licenses/.

bundled.licenseText: resources/licenses/sing-box-v1.14.0-GPL-3.0.txt (full canonical GPLv3, 674 lines) + resources/licenses/sing-box-v1.14.0-LICENSE-notice.txt (the upstream LICENSE file, verbatim, 17 lines — includes sing-box's name-association clause)
bundled.licenseProvenance: Verified live 2026-09-20: the upstream LICENSE at tag v1.14.0 is the GNU GPL notice header ('version 3 ... or (at your option) any later version', Copyright (C) 2022 nekohasekai) WITHOUT the full text embedded — so the full canonical GPLv3 text rides separately (sha256 8ceb4b9e... is the well-known digest of the canonical gnu.org gpl-3.0.txt; fetched from the gcc-mirror/gcc COPYING3 canonical copy because gnu.org is unreachable from the build sandbox; upstream notice fetched from the pinned tag).
bundled.delivery: Bundled, version-pinned, NO auto-download: resources/sing-box/sing-box.exe placed from the official release zip (sha256-pinned in resources/sing-box/README.md: 3ffb56267da14e287be48bd10cf7e6505260125bad940b75101fbb4d5d58e5d6).
bundled.compliance: GPL-3.0: MEMENTO spawns the unmodified sing-box.exe as a separate process through its documented CLI/config interface (no linking) — an aggregate, not a derivative. Obligations honored: (a) the verbatim license text rides in resources/licenses/; (b) corresponding source for the pinned binary is publicly available at the sourceTag above, recorded here and in NOTICE.md (the complete-source-offer path).
bundled.notes: The upstream LICENSE notice adds: 'no derivative work may use the name or imply association with this application without prior consent' — MEMENTO makes no such claim.

bundled.name: Aether

bundled.delivery: Bundled, version-pinned, NO auto-download: resources/aether/aether.exe from the official CluvexStudio release assets (zip sha256 5c64be2f2967469c53abdbec82599cb3c2ef005b8ef8efed79ba235d4ed3eb8d; binary win32 sha256 ee400806bf73fe16e655e6478eb7442c2c4e0576c4c8ce1913ac474e846b36cd, linux e8b2a83c4ab0ad1a75dac21f2f2b9d701998f86866fde15025ffba307b7130b9) — re-verified before EVERY start by the integrity gate in electron/aether.ts.
bundled.compliance: AGPL-3.0: MEMENTO spawns the unmodified aether.exe as a separate process via its documented AETHER_* environment interface (no linking) — remote-network §13 is not triggered by a local child process, and distribution obligations reduce to the GPL-style duties: the verbatim license text rides in resources/licenses/ and the corresponding source is publicly available at the sourceTag above (recorded here and in NOTICE.md).
bundled.notes: 'Aether' is a project by CluvexStudio. MEMENTO is an UNOFFICIAL wrapper: independent UI, no affiliation; the upstream TRADEMARK.md reserves the name (attribution shown in the Aether tab).

runtimeFetched.name: Xray geodata (geoip.dat + geosite.dat)
runtimeFetched.version: the release assets of the PINNED Xray-core v25.1.1
runtimeFetched.role: routing datasets for geosite:/geoip: rules; fetched on demand by electron/geoFiles.ts into the user data dir (XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET); a missing file is fatal at core start
runtimeFetched.licenseId: Lineage attribution: the XTLS geofiles are built from the v2fly datasets — v2fly/geoip (CC BY-SA 4.0, verified live 2026-09-20 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/v2fly/geoip/master/LICENSE) and v2fly/domain-list-community (MIT, verified live 2026-09-20 via the Arch package metadata + repo). GeoLite2-derived records inside v2fly/geoip carry MaxMind's own attribution requirements.
runtimeFetched.compliance: Not bundled — installed into the user's data dir at runtime. Attribution is carried here and in NOTICE.md (CC BY-SA share-alike satisfied by the attribution chain to v2fly/geoip); the files ride the XTLS release channel exactly as the pinned core's own assets.

runtimeFetched.name: sing-box .srs rule-sets (geosite-ir.srs, geoip-ir.srs, geosite-category-ads-all.srs)
runtimeFetched.version: the 'sing' branch tip of MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat at fetch time
runtimeFetched.role: sing-box binary rule-set twins of the Xray geo categories; fetched on demand by electron/geoFiles.ts into dataDir()/sing-box/
runtimeFetched.licenseId: NO standalone license file is published on that branch (verified live 2026-09-20: LICENSE returns HTTP 404 on both the 'sing' and 'meta' branches). The datasets are community redistributions of the v2fly families (v2fly/geoip CC BY-SA 4.0; v2fly/domain-list-community MIT) — the same lineage as the Xray geodata entry above.
runtimeFetched.compliance: Recorded honestly: the app fetches these community files at runtime into the user data dir; attribution to MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat and the underlying v2fly datasets is carried here and in NOTICE.md. If upstream ever publishes a license, this entry gets updated in the same reviewed commit.
